{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Number of -1 values in customer_age:", (data['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Inspect revenue column
print("First few revenue values:", data['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Check for the QA orders
print("Number of rows with revenue = 999999.99:", (data['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Check for refunded orders
print("Number of refunded orders:", (data['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Check channel and customer_segment distribution
print("Channel distribution:", data['channel'].value_counts().to_dict())
print("Customer segment distribution:", data['customer_segment'].value_counts().to_dict())"}
